How Kiro Reads Your Codebase Before Designing

Kiro doesn't design in a vacuum.
Before writing design.md, Kiro analyzes your existing code structure.
It matches new features to your current patterns and conventions.
That's why its suggestions usually feel like your own code, not generic AI output.

Episode 25 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
